standard.name: MIGS (Minimum Information about a Genome Sequence) / MIMS
standard.abstract: MIGS/MIMS specifies metadata for genomic sequence submissions and related samples. It covers description of the investigation and project, sample geographic and environmental context (latitude/longitude, country/region, biome, material, environmental feature), and experimental/ontological annotations. The recording modality is structured metadata (spreadsheet/checklist values for repository submission) accompanying sequence data (e.g. SRA/GenBank).

classification.rationale: The source is a spreadsheet-style checklist (MIGS/MIMS sheet) with explicit named fields, value syntax, occurrence and expected-value columns — a genuine metadata table.
